title: Ganoderic acid A slows osteoarthritis progression by attenuating endoplasmic reticulum stress and blocking NF-Kappab pathway.
authors: Liu, Yuan; Zhou, Chuankun; Tan, Jianye; Wu, Tianlong; Pan, Chongzhi; Liu, Jiahao; Cheng, Xigao
one_liner_zh: 研究灵芝酸A通过抑制内质网应激和NF-κB通路缓解骨关节炎，仅含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a prevalent degenerative pathology, however, there exists a lack of cost-effective pharmacological interventions that efficaciously inhibit its progression. ganoderic acid A (GAA), a triterpenoid derived from Ganoderma lucidum, possesses antiapoptotic and -inflammatory effects. Our objective was to better understand the therapeutic effects of GAA on OA as well as to elucidate the underlying mechanisms of its action. To establish an OA cell model in vitro, chondrocytes (CHONs) were treated with interleukin (IL)-1beta. Subsequently, the investigation was conducted afterward according to the following indicators: cell viability, apoptosis, inflammation, and extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation. Western blotting analysis (WB) was employed to assess both endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and proteins associated with the nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway. Furthermore, based on molecular docking studies, GAA exhibits a significant binding competence to p65. OA mouse models were constructed by performing a destabilization medial meniscus (DMM) operation. Moreover, histopathology and immunohistochemistry were used to determine the GAA therapeutic effect in reducing OA in vivo. Our findings revealed that GAA has antiapoptotic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-ECM degradation effects by inhibiting the ER stress and NF-kappaB axis in CHONs in vitro. Furthermore, our findings suggest that GAA may attenuate the progression of osteoarthritis in vivo. GAA can protect CHONs by regulating apoptosis, ECM changes, and inflammation thereby preventing OA progression. These promising results indicate that GAA may be a therapeutic agent for OA treatment.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种常见的退行性病理改变，然而，目前缺乏经济有效的药物干预措施来有效抑制其进展。灵芝酸A（GAA），一种源自灵芝的三萜类化合物，具有抗凋亡和抗炎作用。我们的目标是更好地理解GAA对OA的治疗效果，并阐明其作用机制。为在体外建立OA细胞模型，用白细胞介素（IL）-1β处理软骨细胞（CHONs）。随后，根据以下指标进行研究：细胞活力、凋亡、炎症和细胞外基质（ECM）降解。采用蛋白质印迹分析（WB）评估内质网（ER）应激及与核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）信号通路相关的蛋白。此外，基于分子对接研究，GAA对p65表现出显著的结合能力。通过进行内侧半月板失稳（DMM）手术构建OA小鼠模型。此外，使用组织病理学和免疫组织化学确定GAA在体内减轻OA的治疗效果。我们的研究结果显示，GAA通过抑制CHONs中的ER应激和NF-kappaB轴，具有抗凋亡、抗炎和抗ECM降解作用。此外，我们的发现表明GAA可能在体内减缓骨关节炎的进展。GAA通过调节凋亡、ECM变化和炎症来保护CHONs，从而预防OA进展。这些有前景的结果表明，GAA可能成为治疗OA的治疗药物。
